surface: vite dev server, localhost:4231, chromium (playwright 1.61.1), ?game=sudoku, drawer OPEN (the shipped default)
culprit: the row-regime board cap `calc(100dvh - 10rem)` (GameBoard boardSizeClasses) budgets 160px of chrome; `.board-margin` — the caption/status strip — is `position:absolute; top:100%` at >=1024, so its `margin-top:0.4rem` plus its one reserved line hang outside every box the page column measures. Nothing in the 10rem ever paid for them.

derivation.noteH: the caption line box = var(--type-body) * var(--type-leading-caption); 23.92@1366w, 23.61@1280w, 22.72@1024w
derivation.why_clean_at_900_1080: the 42rem width rung binds instead of the dvh cap, so the column keeps real slack

cure: App.vue — `.board-group:not(.is-gallery) { padding-bottom: calc(0.4rem + var(--type-body) * var(--type-leading-caption)) }` at >=1024, BOTH drawer poses. The strip's own two authored constants, so the reservation cannot drift from what it reserves. The CAP IS NOT TOUCHED: `100dvh - 10rem` is a golden subject (1280x800 draws a 640 board; the cell and grid-corner goldens read that size).
